sentences.en: The scientist used the test tube to mix chemicals for her experiment.
sentences.zh: 这位科学家用试管混合化学药品做实验。

sentences.en: He sterilized the test tubes before starting his biology class.
sentences.zh: 他上课前把试管消毒了。

sentences.en: She accidentally broke a glass test tube while in the lab.
sentences.zh: 她在实验室里不小心打碎了一个玻璃试管。
